svg.aria-label: el-bm-p006: Elian, Mira, Orin and Sable share one tense platform; four distinct mature adult silhouettes and eyelines, no duplicated faces, open top band. Elian and Mira remain exact. Orin Pell is a broad compact 41-year-old light-olive forge-medic with graying dark hair, short boxed beard and rust-red apron. Sable Renn is a wiry 35-year-old fair cool-complexioned woman with amber eyes, black undercut, silver temple streak, fitted black-plum coat and segmented straight saber.
